prospero_win.status: development-source; release kit and native acceptance pending
prospero_win.note: Up to 80b7cad (Wine patch 1027 for vkd3d-proton's shared heaps, #574): see this file's git history. f6e5fbb keeps controller 0 connected and idle until the title's pad first comes, so a game that looks for controllers only at start sees a DualShock 4 bridged in by PoorDS4, and leaves the pad to a system menu over the title (the title shell changes), from the next kit too. 1401d18 adds [runtime] system_locale and user_locale, which the title sets as LC_CTYPE and LC_MESSAGES, and Wine patch 1028, which reads them when the libc has no locales (code page 932 for Japanese games, #1025; ntdll.prx and the title shell change), from the next kit with capability windows-locale. 64d8f48 corrects the docs: in Wine user_locale sets only the UI language, and the formats follow system_locale; docs only. 99b45f1 adds controller audio: the title logs the audio port state and can route a game to the controller's headset (PW_AUDIO_ROUTE, off by default), Wine gets a Microphone capture endpoint fed by the player's microphone through libSceAudioIn (looked up with sceKernelDlsym, since the firmware leaves the title's weak imports at 0), and [audio] volume and microphone (ntdll.prx, wineps5.prx and the title shell change), from the next kit with capabilities audio-capture, settings-audio-volume and audio-microphone. ec68abc turns the capture lab into a window with Record and Play buttons and device states; test program only. d66bdab gives a game silence for as long as a failed microphone read blocked, so its capture no longer falls behind (wineps5.prx changes). e281d24 adds a microphone check at title start, off unless [debug] env PW_AUDIO_MIC_PROBE=1. c3847a3 opens and closes the microphone once as the title starts: the first open sets up the link to the audio service, and made from the game's capture thread every read timed out, so games heard nothing (the title shell changes). All from the next kit. 661a7d5 returns a host with only an IPv4 address as ::ffff:a.b.c.d to an AF_INET6 lookup with AI_V4MAPPED, as Windows does, for PlayFab Party's dual-stack socket (Killer Instinct's match search, #1102; ws2_32.prx changes), from the next kit too. 170eea5 documents that a swapchain idle for 150 ms gives VideoOut's display to the next one made (PS5_Mesa 9db3f34, RADV's libvulkan.prx, for Unity's first start, #1142); the kit gets it when its RADV is built from that revision. eaccec6 keeps a button bound to a key or a mouse button off the game's XInput or DualShock 4 controller, so it sends only its binding (#1139; the title shell changes), from the next kit too. 6749e72, 1a2cc69, 66ef044 and 4d2f33a add Wine 1029-1036 (each off unless a profile asks) and a storefront launcher run as the title's helper. 4159513..35def4c add the input map (docs/INPUT_MAP.md, `map = 1` in [input]) and Wine 1037 (side mouse buttons) and 1038 (title input sent from one thread), from the next kit with capability input-map (#443). 81277ac gives a [helper] launcher under Z:\mnt\usb\ the drive the game was found on (the title shell changes), from the next kit too. a7c34bc documents that RADV's PS5 winsys also splits a long submission before a buffer copy, fill or update (PS5_Mesa 5693c26, RADV's libvulkan.prx, for Order of the Sinking Star's first frame, #1181); the kit gets it when its RADV is built from that revision.

prospero_kit.status: Kit 0.33, installed as playden-kit. Kit 0.32 with ntdll.prx, win32u.prx, wineserver.prx, ntdll.dll and kernelbase.dll of prospero-win 35def4c and its any-title shell, which plays a profile's controller layout (`map = 1` in [input], capability input-map, #443). Wine 1037 sends the side mouse buttons, 1038 sends the title's input from one thread so key combinations keep their order; 1022, 1023, 1029-1036 (a storefront launcher as the title's helper, and fixes each off unless a profile asks) come with them. The template's ntdll.dll and kernelbase.dll copies change; DXVK and Mono are 0.32's, so bottles need no Recreate.
prospero_kit.runtime_inventory_source: Kit 0.33: staged by kits/kit-0.33/stage.py in the kit archive: kit 0.32 with ntdll.prx, win32u.prx and wineserver.prx (the only .prx that differ in a release cross build of 35def4c, scripts/build-kit-cross.sh --no-reuse, kit-h/work/wine-ps5-033-1), ntdll.dll and kernelbase.dll (x64, i386 and the template's copies) from that build, and the any-title shell built from a clean clone of 35def4c. Earlier kits: see this file's git history.
